desc.text:
<color=#ffd780>Elemental Skill</color>
Deals 2 <color=#80c0ff>Hydro DMG</color> , then performs <color=#ffffff>Prepare Skill</color> for <color=#ffffff>Overflow</color> .
<color=#ebe4d8>Overflow</color>
<color=#ffd680>Elemental Skill</color>
Deals 1 <color=#80c0ff>Hydro DMG</color> .

<color=#ffd780>Elemental Burst</color>
Deals 2 <color=#80c0ff>Hydro DMG</color> and summons <color=#ffffff>Water Droplet</color> .

<color=#ffd680>Passive Skill</color>
(Passive) When the battle begins, this character starts with <color=#ffffff>Hydro Crystal Core</color> attached. If <color=#ffffff>Water Droplet</color> is on the field when <color=#ffffff>Hydro Crystal Core</color> is consumed: Reattach <color=#ffffff>Hydro Crystal Core</color> , and decreases the Usage(s) of <color=#ffffff>Water Droplet</color> by 1.
<color=#ebe4d8>Hydro Crystal Core</color>
<color=#ffd680>Status</color>
<color=#ffffff>When the character to which this is attached would be defeated:</color> Remove this effect, ensure the character <color=#ffffff>will not be defeated</color> , and heal them to 1 HP.

<color=#ffd680>Summon</color>
<color=#ffffff>End Phase:</color> If your <color=#ffffff>Hydro Hypostasis</color> does not have <color=#ffffff>Hydro Crystal Core</color> attached, attach <color=#ffffff>Hydro Crystal Core</color> to this character. Otherwise, deal 2 <color=#80c0ff>Hydro DMG</color> .
<color=#ffffff>Usage(s)</color> : 2

Applies Hydro and can trigger the following Elemental Reactions:
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> <color=#ffffff>+</color> <color=#ff9999>Pyro</color> <color=#ffffff>] Vaporize</color> : DMG +2 for this instance
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> <color=#ffffff>+</color> <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> <color=#ffffff>] Electro-Charged</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, deal 1 Piercing DMG to all opposing characters except the target
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> <color=#ffffff>+</color> <color=#99ffff>Cryo</color> <color=#ffffff>] Frozen</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, the target is unable to perform any Actions this Round (Can be removed in advance after the target receives +2 Physical or Pyro DMG)
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> <color=#ffffff>+</color> <color=#99ff88>Dendro</color> <color=#ffffff>] Bloom</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, creates a [ <color=#ffffff>Dendro Core</color> ] that grants +2 DMG to the next instance of Pyro or Electro DMG
[ <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> + <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Lunar-Charged:</color> Creates a [ <color=#ffffff>Thundercloud</color> ] that deals 2 <color=#ffacff>Electro DMG</color> at the end of the Round. (Usage: 1. Can stack, no stack limit. When created or when its usages increase, apply [ <color=#ffffff>Electric Shock</color> ] to a random card in your opponent's Hand.)

<color=#ece5d8>Prepare Skill</color>
Some Skills cannot be used directly. Instead, they need to be <color=#ffffff>prepared</color> over a certain number of turns.
When it is a certain player's turn, and this player's active character is currently <color=#ffffff>preparing</color> a Skill, this player's turn will be skipped. If the Skill has finished being <color=#ffffff>prepared</color> , the character will directly use that Skill at this time. (Skills that require <color=#ffffff>preparing</color> cannot activate effects triggered by "using a Skill" or "triggering an Elemental Reaction" or other such effects.)
Only active characters can <color=#ffffff>prepare</color> Skills, and if an active character who is <color=#ffffff>preparing</color> a Skill gets switched off-field, their <color=#ffffff>preparation</color> will be interrupted.
<color=#ebe4d8>Usage(s)</color>
After this card's effect is triggered, 1 <color=#ffffff>Usage</color> of it will be consumed.
This card will be discarded immediately once it has 0 <color=#ffffff>Usages</color> remaining.
<color=#ece5d8>Immunity to Defeat</color>
Certain effects will grant characters an <color=#ffffff>immunity to being defeated</color> when their HP hits 0, and will heal them for a certain amount thereafter.
When this occurs, characters will not be regarded as having experienced a <color=#ffffff>defeat.</color> (Hence, their attached equipment and statuses will not be removed, and their Energy will remain uncleared.)
